_ordering_rationale: FISV (Fiserv, ticker FI depuis 2023). Pilier business : Merchant Solutions (Clover/Small Business hypercroissance) > Financial Solutions (Issuing/Digital Payments) > Banking (legacy). Order par PV : Small Business / Clover en tete, puis nouveaux segments Acceptance.
_ticker_note: Fiserv a change de ticker NYSE en juillet 2023 (FISV -> FI). Donnees post-2023 a publier de preference sous fiche FI. Structure segmentaire reorganisee debut 2024 : ancien Acceptance/Fintech/Payments -> nouveau Merchant Solutions / Financial Solutions.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Clover : moteur principal Fiserv, croissance forte. ~67% du Merchant Solutions FY25.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Sous-segment Small Business du Merchant Solutions. Inclut Clover (POS cloud + business management) et ISVs. Croissance ~10%/an, plus haute marge. Pilier valorisation Fiserv.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Small Business sub-segment of Merchant Solutions. Includes Clover (cloud POS + business management) and ISVs. ~10%/year growth, highest margin. Fiserv valuation pillar.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Segment commerce-enabling > $10Mds. Croissance ~9%/an, devenu plus gros que Financial.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Segment Merchant Solutions complet : Small Business (Clover), Enterprise, Processing. Devenu en FY24 le plus gros segment Fiserv devant Financial Solutions.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Full Merchant Solutions segment: Small Business (Clover), Enterprise, Processing. Became Fiserv's largest segment in FY24 ahead of Financial Solutions.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Plus gros sous-segment Financial Solutions, croissance ralentie a +2% FY25.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Sous-segment Digital Payments du Financial Solutions : Zelle, debit network STAR, e-paiements B2B/P2P. Forte exposition consumer payments US.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Digital Payments sub-segment of Financial Solutions: Zelle, STAR debit network, B2B/P2P e-payments. Heavy US consumer payments exposure.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Croissance soutenue card issuing, segment haute marge processing.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Sous-segment Issuing : card processing pour banques émettrices (credit, debit, prepaid). Inclut output solutions (statements, embossing). Marge processing.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Issuing sub-segment: card processing for issuer banks (credit, debit, prepaid). Includes output solutions (statements, embossing). Processing margin.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Stagnation legacy core banking ~$2,4-2,5Mds, segment a faible croissance vs Merchant.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Sous-segment Banking : core processing pour banques régionales et community banks US. Legacy First Data + Open Solutions. Croissance faible/stagnante.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Banking sub-segment: core processing for US regional and community banks. Legacy First Data + Open Solutions. Low/flat growth.

kpis_supplementary.signal: $21Mds revenue FY25 vs $16Mds FY22 : croissance organique + acquisitions.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Chiffre d'affaires consolide. Croissance moyenne ~7%/an FY22-FY25, mix Merchant en hausse vs Banking en stagnation.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Consolidated revenue. ~7%/year average growth FY22-FY25, mix shifting toward Merchant vs flat Banking.

_extraction_method: 10-K filings cat1-us 2023-2026 (FY22-FY25 data). Tables segmentaires Merchant Solutions / Financial Solutions extraites. Aucune valeur inventee. Structure segmentaire FY22 reportee dans 10-K 2025 sous nouveau format.
